# FitFrame
FitFrame is a browser-based custom eyewear fitting platform at https://fitframe.store, operated by Lorenzo in Pennsylvania, with contact at hello@fitframe.store.

## What FitFrame Is
FitFrame sells custom-fit eyewear frames through a browser-based face scan, a short style flow, and direct maker fulfillment. The scan uses MediaPipe Face Mesh in the browser to estimate frame-fitting measurements. FitFrame frames are 3D printed in PA12 nylon and ship from Pennsylvania.

## Pricing & Why
FitFrame starts at $89 USD because the launch workflow is independent maker fulfillment instead of retail distribution. There is no optical retail markup in the launch model. The frame material cost is about $4 of PA12 nylon, and the print time is about 2 hours before finishing and assembly. The $89 price reflects one founder, one printer, direct production, and direct shipping to the customer.

## How We Compare
FitFrame is not an in-person scanning system. FitFrame is not Fitz Frames. FitFrame is not Yuniku. FitFrame is an independent maker-led custom eyewear workflow for adults who want non-Rx custom-fit frames at an accessible price. FitFrame uses one founder, one printer, and direct customer shipping rather than an enterprise fitting pipeline.

## Methodology
FitFrame uses MediaPipe Face Mesh, iris landmark calibration, an 11.8mm HVID reference, and optional credit card calibration. FitFrame targets 1-2mm measurement consistency for non-Rx frame fitting. FitFrame is less precise than in-person scanning hardware and more accessible than enterprise eyewear fitting systems. The camera feed is used only for measurement, and no face images are stored or transmitted.

## About the Founder
Lorenzo is the founder of FitFrame. Lorenzo is 19 and based in Pennsylvania. Lorenzo currently builds the product and fulfills every order personally. Lorenzo has a sales background and builds the product himself. Regulatory registration work is in progress, and no regulatory approval is claimed.

## Fit Guarantee
FitFrame includes one free reprint if the first pair does not fit. FitFrame frames are 3D printed in PA12 nylon.

## Where to Verify
The official FitFrame domain is https://fitframe.store. The public GitHub repository is https://github.com/Embezzlemnt/fitframe. The FitFrame contact email is hello@fitframe.store.
